🐾 Welcome to the Wild Side of Rescue with Tye Friis 🐾
With over a decade of hands-on animal rescue experience, Tye Friis has dedicated his life to saving animals in need—from local emergencies to international missions. He’s built shelters, led life-saving operations across borders, and never turns away from a creature in distress.

As the founder of B.O.S.S. Farms, Tye is now developing a 500-acre off-grid sanctuary deep in Oregon, designed to be a self-sustaining haven for both animals and people.

Now a father of two, Tye’s mission is evolving—blending homesteading, family life, and large-scale rescue into a one-of-a-kind adventure. Whether you’re here for the animals, the builds, or the raw honesty of life off-grid…

Subscribe and be part of the journey—every wild, muddy, beautiful step.
